description.value: The Bagel Stop is a Canadian franchise chain founded in 1987, specialising in freshly baked bagels and handcrafted deli sandwiches made without preservatives. The Vancouver outlet appears to occupy a basement food-court unit (Level -1, Unit 313) within the 595 Burrard Street office tower in the downtown core. The brand operates in high-traffic locations such as office towers and food courts across Canada.
